{{Top|canon=Rainbow storm}}
'''Rainbow storm''', or '''Prisma storm''', as it was also known, was a weather phenomena that occurred on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. This brilliant display occurred when the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] traveled behind [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] and spent time in its shadow. As a result, nights would get very cold, and water crystals would form in the upper atmosphere. As the moon came out behind Yavin Prime, the sunlight from [[Yavin/Legends|Yavin]] would be shattered by millions of prisms. The light would dance and crackle through sky to give the effect of varicolored lightning and swirling rainbows. It only lasted a few minutes, before the sun rose enough to light all of Yavin 4.

Rainbow storm was first recorded by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Naturalist/Legends|naturalist]] [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]], who saw it when he came to Yavin 4 with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He told the other Rebels about it, and some would make a point of climbing up high every day to watch it. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] noted the names of some of these people and assigned them to the newly constructed watch towers.

[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] would later watch the phenomena, when he came to the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on Yavin 4 in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].
